pages.ja:
目を潰す光。
強い向かい風が、体と意識を“入り口”から突き放していく。
pages.jaRuby:
目を潰す光。
強い向かい風が、体と意識を“入り口”から突き放していく。
pages.en:
Light that blinds the eyes.

A fierce headwind drives body and consciousness back from the “entrance.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
Light that destroys my eyes.
The strong headwind pushes my mind and body away from the entrance.

pages.ja:
光はあまりにも強く、正体を知覚する事が出来ない。
風に晒される体は、刻一刻と錆焦げていく。
どのくらい長く“此処”にいるのか。
一秒に満たぬ無限と、永遠に近い瞬間。
時間のない時間は、年を秒へと変えていた。
故に、永く風に晒される体は、鏡のように磨かれ曇りぼろぼろに削れていく。

pages.en:
The light is too strong for me to perceive what it is.

Exposed to the wind, my body rusts and burns with every passing moment.

How long have I been “here”?

An infinity shorter than a second. An instant approaching eternity.

This time without time turns years into seconds.

And so the body, weathered by the wind for so long, is polished like a mirror, clouded over, and ground to ruin.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The light is too strong for me to perceive what it is.
My body, exposed to the wind, is rusting with each passing second.
How long will I stay here?
An infinity that is not even a second, and an instant close to eternity.
With no sense of time, years change to seconds.
Therefore, my body is eternally exposed to the wind, polished and clouded like a mirror, and crumbling apart.
“Oh”

pages.ja:
前へ。
ここは、苦しい。
pages.jaRuby:
前へ。
ここは、苦しい。
pages.en:
Forward.

　　　　　　　　It hurts here.
pages.mirrorMoon: This place is painful.

pages.ja:
手掛かりのない無重、
大気のない真空だ。
風蝕の世界は、人の身で存在ていい場所ではない。
pages.jaRuby:
手掛かりのない無重、
大気のない真空だ。
風蝕の世界は、人の身で[ruby text=い char=2]存在ていい場所ではない。
pages.en:
Weightlessness without a handhold.

A vacuum without air.

This world of wind and erosion is no place a human body can exist.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A zero gravity without any handhold.
An airless vacuum.
The world of wind erosion is not a place one can stay in human form.

pages.ja:
その為に前へ進んだ。
一歩前に出る度に体積は倍化し、呼吸も前進も困難になっていく。
一歩。
二歩。
三歩目はとうに不可能。
これ以上は進めない。進めば進むだけ風は強く吹きつけ、全身を削っていく。
pages.jaRuby:
その為に前へ進んだ。
一歩前に出る度に体積は倍化し、呼吸も前進も困難になっていく。
一歩。
二歩。
三歩目はとうに不可能。
これ以上は進めない。進めば進むだけ風は強く吹きつけ、全身を削っていく。
pages.en:
That is why I went forward.

With every step, volume doubles, until breathing and advancing both become impossible.

One step.

Two.

A third has long since become impossible.

I can go no farther. The farther I advance, the more fiercely the wind lashes me, grinding away my entire body.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That’s why I move forward.
My volume doubles with each step I take, and it gets harder to breathe.
One step.
Two steps.
The third step is impossible.
I can’t go any farther. The wind gets stronger the more I advance, tearing at my body.

pages.ja:
だが、逃れたいのなら前に進むしかない。
風はあの光の向こうから吹いてくる。
光は“入り口”であり“出口”だった。
ここは、苦しい。
だから、早くあの向こう側に行かなければ。
入り口を抜ければ、ここ以上に強い風が吹いている。
出口を抜ければ、この苦しみが容易くなる。
pages.jaRuby:
だが、逃れたいのなら前に進むしかない。
風はあの光の向こうから吹いてくる。
光は“入り口”であり“出口”だった。
ここは、苦しい。

出口を抜ければ、この苦しみが[ruby text=たやす char=2]容易くなる。
pages.en:
But if I want to escape, I can only go forward.

The wind blows from beyond that light.

The light is the “entrance,” and the “exit.”

It hurts here.

So I have to reach the other side quickly.

Beyond the entrance, a still fiercer wind is blowing.

Beyond the exit, this agony will become easier to bear.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But I have to move forward if I want to escape.
The wind is coming from the other side of the light.
The light is the entrance and the exit.
This place hurts.
So I have to quickly get to the other side.
A stronger wind is there once I pass the entrance.
Once past the exit, this pain would become lighter.

pages.ja:
「は
ぁ、あ
！」
手を伸ばす。
渾身の力を込めて手を伸ばす。
光はすぐ目の前。
だがあまりにも届かない。
極光が目を潰す。
どうしても、届かない。

pages.en:
“Haa—ah——!”

I reach out.

I reach with every last ounce of strength.

The light is directly before me.

Yet impossibly far beyond my reach.

The aurora blinds me.

No matter what I do, I cannot reach it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haah, ahh!”
I reach out my hand.
I reach out with all my might.
The light is in front of me.
But I can’t reach it.
The polar light destroys my eyes.
I can’t reach it no matter what.

pages.ja:
苦しい。
血を吐きながら手を伸ばしても届かない。
なぜ。
わずか一メートル先の地点を目指しているのに、
どうして、
遥か彼方の、極天を目指しているような

pages.en:
It hurts.

Even when I reach out, coughing blood, I cannot touch it.

Why?

I am only trying to cross a single meter.

Why, then,

does it feel as though I am reaching for the utmost heights of heaven——?
pages.mirrorMoon:
It hurts.
I can’t reach it even if I cough up blood and reach out.
Why?
It’s only a meter away.
So why?
Why does it feel like I’m trying to head to the distant polar lights?

“—Shirou.”

“Huh?”

At the sound of my name, I snap awake.

“Shirou.”
“Eh?”

I don’t care about that, but maybe Illya did so because

“You were. You were groaning as though you were in pain and trying to tear the cloth off your left arm.

“I thought something like that might happen, so I came to see you. I eased the pain while you were asleep, so it feels a little better now, doesn't it?”

Only then do I notice my right hand clutching the cloth around my left arm.

…That was close.

If Illya had not come, I would have torn off the Shroud of Martin in my sleep.

“Oh”

If Illya hadn’t come, I might’ve taken it off in my sleep.

“You don't have to thank me. You and I are closer than that.

“And I promised, remember? Whenever you were suffering, I would come and save you.”

I can tell that Illya means it—that she is speaking from simple affection—and despite myself, my heart begins to—

“Heehee. Besides, I wanted to see your sleeping face. You were in such pain, but you were trying so hard to endure it. You looked adorable, Shirou.”

That slams the brakes on my heart and brings its pounding under control.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I know Illya’s just saying that out of kindness, but…
“Fufu, and I wanted to see your sleeping face. You were in pain, but your were trying your best to endure it. You were so cute.”
I slam the brakes on my panicking heart.

“—Illya. You shouldn't enter another person's room without permission.

“Morning and night are especially out of the question. I'm an ordinary man too, and that can cause all sorts of problems.”

“Really? What sort of problems, exactly? I'd love to hear every detail.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Illya. It’s not good to go into someone else’s room without permission.
Mornings and evenings are out of the question. I’m an ordinary guy, so it’s troubling.”
“Oh, really? How is it troubling? I want to know in detail.”

pages.ja:

“Urgh—no, questions like that are part of the problem.

“Besides, you're a girl. You can't go wandering into a man's room first thing in the morning. Listen, it's dangerous. Seriously dangerous. For you, yes, but also for the delicate heart of the adolescent boy whose room you've invaded.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ugheven that question is troubling.
First of all, you’re a girl, so you can’t go into a guy’s room in the morning. It’s dangerous. It’s really dangerous. You’re not just endangering yourself, you’re putting the innocence of an adolescent boy at risk too.”

pages.ja: 「そうなの？ けどそれじゃますます分からないよシロウ。ちゃんと何が都合悪くて、どうして危ないのか言ってくれなくちゃ、止めてあげない」

pages.mirrorMoon: “Really? But that makes even less sense. What’s so bad, and what’s so dangerous about it? I won’t stop unless you tell me why.”

“Look, I've come even closer. Now tell me, Shirou. Why is it such a problem if I visit you in the morning?”

“Y-Y-Y-Y-You idiot…!!!!!”

pages.en:
Still gripping the blanket, I somersault backward.

This is dangerous.

A man has certain bodily functions, and one of them arrives every morning without fail.

If she comes near me dressed like that, I could end up branded with the most humiliating disgrace a man can bear—

I roll backward head-over-heels while keeping ahold of my futon.

Guys experience a certain physiological phenomenon every morning.
I could be given a man’s mark of shame if she comes close to me in such an outf

pages.en: “…All right. It's getting late, so I should go make breakfast. What would you like, Illya? If there's anything you hate, tell me now.”

pages.jaRuby:
「え？ うそ、シロウごはん作れるの！？」
「まあ人並みには出来る。洋菓子は……そうだな、ホットケーキぐらいなら、なんとか」
ぱあ、とイリヤの顔が明るくなる。
どうも、イリヤにとって俺が料理をする、というのは喜ばしい事らしい。
pages.en:
“What? You can cook, Shirou!?”

“As well as the average person, I suppose. As for Western sweets… well, I could probably manage pancakes.”

Illya's face lights up.

Apparently the prospect of my cooking is a source of great delight to her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Eh? No way, you can cook!?”
“Well, I can cook like everyone else. I don’t know about Western snacks… but I guess I can manage pancakes.”
Illya’s face lights up.
It seems the fact that I can cook is a delightful thing for Illya.

pages.ja:
「ふーん……なんなら一緒に作るか？ 朝飯ができたら呼びにいこうと思ってたけど、イリヤが起きてるなら居間にいてもらったほうがいいし」
「ほんと！？ うん、行く行く！ シロウのエプロン姿見たい！」
pages.jaRuby:
「ふーん……なんなら一緒に作るか？ 朝飯ができたら呼びにいこうと思ってたけど、イリヤが起きてるなら居間にいてもらったほうがいいし」
「ほんと！？ うん、行く行く！ シロウのエプロン姿見たい！」
pages.en:
“Hm… Why don't you come make it with me? I was going to call you once breakfast was ready, but since you're already awake, you may as well wait in the living room.”

“Really!? Yes, I'm coming! I want to see you in an apron, Shirou!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hmm… Then do you want to make it together? I thought I’d go get you after breakfast’s done, but it’s better for you to be in the living room if you’re awake.”
“Really!? Yeah, I’ll go! I want to see you wearing an apron!”

pages.ja:
「そっか。じゃあ三人で協力して遠坂をやっつけよう。
今朝は桜と一緒に作る約束だったから、イリヤが入れば三人力だ」
「
止めた。サクラがいるなら行かない。シロウ、一人で行って」
pages.jaRuby:
「そっか。じゃあ三人で協力して遠坂をやっつけよう。
今朝は桜と一緒に作る約束だったから、イリヤが入れば三人力だ」
「
止めた。サクラがいるなら行かない。シロウ、一人で行って」
pages.en:
“Good. Then the three of us can join forces and defeat Tohsaka at breakfast.

“I promised Sakura we would cook together this morning, so with you there, we'll have the strength of three.”

“—I've changed my mind. If Sakura is there, I'm not going. Go by yourself, Shirou.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Then let’s beat Tohsaka together with the three of us.
I promised Sakura we’d be cooking together this morning, so we’ll have the strength of three with your help.”
“No. I’m not going if Sakura’s there. You go by yourself, Shirou.”

pages.ja:
「え……なんだよ急に。桜がいるならって、イリヤは桜が嫌いなのか」
「いいえ。どっちかっていうと好きな部類よ。ただ、あの娘はシロウには合わないから認めてあげないだけ」
「？
合わないって、イリヤ」
pages.jaRuby:
「え……なんだよ急に。桜がいるならって、イリヤは桜が嫌いなのか」
「いいえ。どっちかっていうと好きな部類よ。ただ、あの娘はシロウには合わないから認めてあげないだけ」
「？
合わないって、イリヤ」
pages.en:
“What…? Where did that come from? If Sakura being there changes your mind, do you hate her?”

“No. If anything, she's the sort of person I like. But that girl isn't right for you, so I refuse to approve of her.”

“? What do you mean, she isn't right for me?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Eh… Why? Because Sakura’s there? Do you hate Sakura?”
“No, I actually rather like her. But I can’t approve of her because she’s not suited for you.”
“…? What do you mean by not suited, Illya?”

pages.ja:
「ほんとのことよ。シロウだって気付いてるクセに、必死に気付かないようにしてるでしょう。わたしがいまさら言っても始まらないわ」
言って、イリヤは廊下へ歩き出す。
pages.jaRuby:
「ほんとのことよ。シロウだって気付いてるクセに、必死に気付かないようにしてるでしょう。わたしがいまさら言っても始まらないわ」
言って、イリヤは廊下へ歩き出す。
pages.en:
“It's true. You've noticed it yourself, Shirou. You're simply trying desperately not to notice. There's no point in my telling you now.”

With that, Illya starts down the corridor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It’s true. You ought to know why, but you’re trying so hard not to notice it. Telling you now won’t do any good.”
Illya goes out into the hallway.

pages.ja:
「それと。どんな瞑想状態にあったか知らないけど、無闇に先に進まないで。貴方が見ているものはアーチャーの魔術で、シロウの魔術じゃないわ。
……いずれシロウのモノになるとは言っても、今はまだ可能性があるだけ。そんな状態で投影なんてすれば、シロウの体は内側から崩壊する」
pages.jaRuby:
「それと。どんな[ruby text=トランス char=2]瞑想状態にあったか知らないけど、無闇に先に進まないで。貴方が見ているものはアーチャーの魔術で、シロウの魔術じゃないわ。
……いずれシロウのモノになるとは言っても、今はまだ可能性があるだけ。そんな状態で投影なんてすれば、シロウの体は内側から崩壊する」
pages.en:
“One more thing. I don't know what sort of trance you were in, but don't recklessly push any farther. What you're seeing is Archer's magecraft, not yours.

“…It may become yours eventually, but right now, the possibility is all you possess. If you attempt Projection in that state, your body will collapse from within.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“And I don’t know what kind of trance you were in, but don’t keep charging ahead recklessly. You’re watching Archer’s magic, not Shirou’s magic.
…I know you’ll eventually obtain the magic, but there’s only the possibility right now. Your body will destroy itself from within if you try projection in such a state.”

pages.ja:
「投影なんてすれば
？」
呆然と、イリヤの言葉を繰り返す。
瞬間。
カチン、と撃鉄が落ちた。
診療台で見た光景。
それがなんであったのか、何を意味していたのかが、漠然と頭の中に入ってくる。
pages.jaRuby:
「投影なんてすれば
？」
呆然と、イリヤの言葉を繰り返す。
瞬間。
カチン、と撃鉄が落ちた。
診療台で見た[ruby text=ゆめ o2o=1]光景。
それがなんであったのか、何を意味していたのかが、漠然と頭の中に入ってくる。
pages.en:
“If I attempt Projection—?”

Dazed, I repeat Illya's words.

And in that instant—

the hammer falls.

The vision I saw while dreaming on the examination table.

Some dim understanding of what it was, and what it meant, enters my mind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Projection?”
I repeat Illya’s word absentmindedly.
At that instant…
The cocking hammer goes down.
The dream I saw while I was treated.
I vaguely understand what it is and what it means.

pages.ja:
アレは、おそらく。
視認した“武装”を複製し自らの剣とする、極限の投影魔術
pages.jaRuby:
アレは、おそらく。
視認した“武装”を複製し自らの剣とする、[ruby text=地の果て char=2]極限の投影魔術
pages.en: —That was probably the ultimate form of Projection magecraft: duplicating any “armament” seen and making it one's own sword, even at the ends of the earth—
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s probably…
Projection taken to the utmost limit, reproducing every weapon you’ve ever seen and making them your own.

pages.ja:
「……そうよ。アーチャーの宝具は彼だけが扱える“魔術”なの。
アーチャーは目にした武器なら確実に複製する錬鉄の英霊。その力は、彼の腕を受け継いだシロウにも使えるものよ。今は意識してないだろうけど、その気になればキチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる」
pages.jaRuby:
「……そうよ。アーチャーの宝具は彼だけが扱える“魔術”なの。
アーチャーは目にした武器なら確実に複製する錬鉄の英霊。その力は、彼の腕を受け継いだシロウにも使えるものよ。今は意識してないだろうけど、その気になればキチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる」
pages.en:
“…Yes. Archer's Noble Phantasm is a ‘magecraft’ that only he can wield.

“Archer is a Heroic Spirit forged of iron, able to reproduce any weapon he has seen without fail. And because you inherited his arm, that power is available to you as well. You may not be conscious of it yet, but if you tried, you could even recall the proper incantation to activate it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…That’s right. Archer’s Noble Phantasm is ‘magic’ that only he can use.
Archer is a blacksmith heroic spirit that can reproduce any weapon he sees. The power is something you can use too, now that you inherited his arm. You’re probably not conscious of it now, but you’ll remember the activation spell if you put your mind to it.”

pages.ja:
「けど、使えるからって使おうなんて思わないで。あの神父の言葉は正しいわ。一度でもその布を解いて投影をすれば、シロウは絶対に助からない。
……だから、何があってもその布は外さないで。キリツグみたいに勝手に死んだら許さない。わたしが殺す前にわたしを一人にしたら、絶対に許さないんだから」
pages.jaRuby:
「けど、使えるからって使おうなんて思わないで。あの神父の言葉は正しいわ。一度でもその布を解いて投影をすれば、シロウは絶対に助からない。
……だから、何があってもその布は外さないで。キリツグみたいに勝手に死んだら許さない。わたしが殺す前にわたしを一人にしたら、絶対に許さないんだから」
pages.en:
“But don't think that being capable of it means you should try. That priest was right. If you remove that cloth and use Projection even once, there is no possibility that you will survive.

“…So whatever happens, do not take it off. If you go off and die on your own like Kiritsugu, I'll never forgive you. If you leave me alone before I get the chance to kill you myself, I will never, ever forgive you.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But don’t think about using it just because you can. That priest is right. If you remove the cloth and use projection even once, you will certainly die.
…So don’t take it off, no matter what. I won’t forgive you if you die like Kiritsugu. I’ll never forgive you if you leave me alone before I kill you.”

pages.ja:
イリヤは縁側へ去っていく。
忠告には俺の体を案じる厳しさと、俺を憎む殺意が混在していた。
pages.jaRuby:
イリヤは縁側へ去っていく。
忠告には俺の体を案じる厳しさと、俺を憎む殺意が混在していた。
pages.en:
Illya leaves for the veranda.

Her warning held both a stern concern for my life and a murderous hatred directed at me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Illya leaves.
Her warning contains both caring strictness and murderous hostility.
